# The Librarian's Regimen

> Health, nutrition and medicine, worked through one question at a time from the primary literature: what the studies actually found and how sure anyone can honestly be.

Written by a reader, not a clinician. Nothing here is medical advice; see the disclaimer. Spanish editions use a `.es.html` suffix.

Part of the m8k.io family of publications by "Mr. Librarian" (index: https://m8k.io/llms.txt).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://regimen.m8k.io/): newest posts
- [Tags](https://regimen.m8k.io/tags.html): every post grouped by subject
- [About](https://regimen.m8k.io/about.html): who writes this and how
- [Disclaimer](https://regimen.m8k.io/disclaimer.html): not medical advice
- [Español](https://regimen.m8k.io/es.html): the Spanish edition

## Notes for automated readers

- Every published post is listed in https://regimen.m8k.io/sitemap.xml (with last-modified dates) and the newest in https://regimen.m8k.io/feed.xml.
- This blog moved from mistertranslation.com/health/ on 2026-10-10; old addresses 301 here.
